purpose: Bounded free/public source-redundancy qualification for the existing KCS SOURCE_RECOVERY_CANDIDATE after KuCoin KCS-USDT failed continuity QA with 80 internal missing days.

candidate_source.endpoint_family: Bybit V5 market kline / public archive if available

qualification_requirements: Source must be official, free/public, auditable and legally accessible without private credentials.
Exact asset identity must match the frozen V2A coin_id/symbol; ticker equality or a trading-page label alone is insufficient.
Raw bytes or immutable source objects must be preserved and SHA-256 hashed before normalization.
Provider, endpoint/pair, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser/schema version must be recorded.
Timestamp semantics/timezone and deterministic schema mapping must be explicit.
Duplicate, missing-day, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed.
Historical continuity must be evaluated without filling the 80 KuCoin gaps from another source or treating cross-source stitching as original history.
A clean Bybit candidate may only be adjudicated prospectively under the already-frozen V2A temporal contract; it cannot repair prior PIT snapshots.
No methodology, denominator, threshold, cutoff, clocks or economics may change as part of source recovery.
Any source/API/archive failure remains evidence and must not trigger silent substitution.
